privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: In short: your images never leave your device.
privacy.s1Body: {{brand}} is a purely front-end application. All image editing, AI cutout, and ID photo operations run locally in your browser. We do not collect, store, or upload any of your image data.
privacy.s2Body: The AI cutout feature uses ONNX Runtime for local inference on your device. Model files are downloaded from a CDN on first use and cached. The inference runs entirely in your browser — no image data is sent to any remote server.
privacy.s3Body: The app uses your browser's localStorage to store preferences (such as theme mode). This data stays on your device and is never synced to the cloud.

homepage.privacyBody: Zan Pic is a 100% client-side application. All image editing, AI inference, and ID photo generation run locally in your browser via ONNX Runtime and WebGPU. We do not collect, store, or upload your images. The AI model downloads once from a CDN and is cached on your device — subsequent uses work fully offline.

faq.a1: Yes. Zan Pic is free to use, with no registration, no watermark, and no usage limits. We display ads on a few pages to support the service.
faq.q2: Are my images uploaded to a server?
faq.a2: No. Every image operation runs locally in your browser. Your images never leave your device. The AI model files (~24MB) are downloaded once and cached on your device.
faq.a3: Upload: PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF, BMP, GIF. Export: PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF with adjustable quality.
faq.q4: Does the AI background remover work on mobile?
faq.a4: Yes. Modern mobile browsers (Chrome, Edge, Safari 17+) support WebGPU. AI cutout takes about 5-10 seconds on a recent phone. The first use downloads the AI model (~24MB); subsequent uses load instantly from cache.
faq.q5: Can I use the exported images commercially?
faq.a5: Yes. The images you create with Zan Pic are entirely yours. We do not claim any rights over your outputs. For uploaded source images, please ensure you have the right to modify them.
faq.q6: Why is the AI cutout slow on first use?
faq.a6: The first cutout downloads the AI model (~24MB) from a CDN. After that, the model is cached locally. WebGPU-capable browsers (Chrome 113+, Edge 113+) run inference 3-10x faster than WASM fallback.
